details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. Revenue stability is explained through offsetting factors (S2), profitability improvements are clearly linked to cost reductions (S3-S4), property valuation gains are justified (S6-S7), and balance sheet improvements are tied to asset sales and debt reduction (S8-S9). The structure progresses logically from revenue to profitability to balance sheet and finally to overall assessment (S15). There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between causes and effects are clearly articulated within the text itself.
